title: Disney Mickey Mouse Coffee Mug, Black & Red, 10oz - Used
descriptionText:
Sip your coffee in style with this 10 oz Disney Mickey Mouse mug. The black and red design adds a touch of playfulness to your morning routine. Made in China with high-quality materials, this mug is perfect for any Disney fan or collector. 

Featuring the iconic Mickey Mouse character, this mug is a must-have addition to your Disneyana collection. The mug is branded with the Disney franchise and is perfect for use at home or in the office. Add some Disney magic to your day with this charming mug.
